name: year
description: Reference year of the index value

name: quarter
description: Reference quarter of the index value

name: cbsa_id
description: Five-digit code of the Metropolitan Statistical Area or Metropolitan Division
observations: No directory link is declared: 37 of the 410 codes are Metropolitan Division (MSAD) codes, which br_bd_diretorios_us.cbsa_2023 does not carry. The remaining 373 resolve against br_bd_diretorios_us.cbsa_2023:id_cbsa.

name: cbsa_name
description: Name of the Metropolitan Statistical Area or Metropolitan Division

name: index_type
description: Index variant: traditional, developmental, distress-free, non-metro or manufactured
observations: The traditional purchase-only seasonally adjusted index is the series FHFA reports in its press releases. non-metro covers the nonmetropolitan remainder of a state rather than the state as a whole; manufactured covers manufactured homes only.

name: index_flavor
description: Underlying transaction data: purchase-only, all-transactions or expanded-data
observations: The three flavours differ by the data feeding the repeat-sales regression, not by the statistical method. Only all-transactions runs before 1991.

name: index_nsa
description: House price index, not seasonally adjusted
observations: The first period of each series is set to 100

name: index_sa
observations: Null wherever FHFA publishes no seasonally adjusted variant of the series

name: relative_standard_error
description: Relative standard error of the index value
observations: Published for the expanded-data metropolitan series only; null elsewhere

name: note
description: Footnote FHFA attaches to the index value
observations: Flags quarters with fewer than 1,000 accumulated repeat-sales records, or a value suppressed for too few records. Null on every other row; the source's literal tab placeholder is cleaned to null.
